description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

John Deere develops technology and equipment to help address global food, fiber, and infrastructure challenges. The Embedded Software Engineer will develop, test, and support embedded software for agricultural equipment, collaborating with systems engineers, software architects, and scrum teams with a focus on Precision Ag.
Embedded software engineer developing, testing, and supporting precision agriculture equipment systems

Responsibilities:
• Be a member of an embedded development scrum team working with multiple stakeholders to build and implement functionality for John Deere agricultural equipment such as In-Field Data Sharing and Logistics
• Collaborate with Systems Engineers, Software Architects, and other teams in the John Deere Tech Stack to design, develop, and test software for a broad spectrum of Deere equipment with a focus on Precision Ag
• Operate as a member in a scrum team environment on varying projects with and provide work direction for team members
• Provide product support and defect triage of those system(s)

Requirements:
• 1 year of demonstrated experience in embedded software development using C++, Python, Java, or other Object-Oriented languages
• Knowledge of CAN & Ethernet protocols and tools
• Experience in design, development, and testing software applications
• Understand real-time operating systems and multi process/thread concepts
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills in a distributed team environment

Preferred:
• Knowledge of IoT Messaging
• Demonstrated understanding of Object-Oriented Principles
• Demonstrated understanding of inter process communication and multi-threading
• Experience working with Ops Center via Embedded Gen4/5 Interfaces
